newsitem.title: DENMARK: CYCLING-HENN WINS DENMARK TOUR THIRD STAGE.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-HENN WINS DENMARK TOUR THIRD STAGE.

text.p: Christian Henn won the 120-km third stage of the Tour of Denmark cycle race on Friday, with the leader's yellow jersey going to fellow German Telekom team mate Giovanni Lombardi.

Henn pedalled past Denmark's Michael Skelde in a splendid last-minute solo spurt to win the stage from Nordborg to Haderslev in southwest Denmark by just two seconds in two hours 37 minutes 28 seconds.
Lombardi, who won Thursday's stage, took over the yellow jersey from Australia's Robbie McEwen, who is now in overall second position.
McEwen came second in the first two stages of the tour.
Altogether, Friday's third stage was an impressive victory for the Telekom team, with four riders in the first 10 and three in the top-10 overall tour standings.
After Henn, Telekom's Brian Holm of Denmark came fifth in the day's placings, with Germany's Jan Schaffrath eighth and Dane Bjarne Riis, the 1996 Tour de France victor, ninth.
In the overall standings after leader Lombardi, Henn is in fourth position with Riis ninth.
